1.title: Federal Prosecutors Charge ICE Agent With Lying About Minnesota Shooting
1.summary: The charges marked a rare instance of President Trump’s Justice Department accusing a federal agent of breaking the law while on the job.

2.title: So It’s Gonna Be Ohio? This Tiny Village Is Ready for Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce.
2.summary: The wealthy enclave of Bratenahl, Ohio, has been aflutter after learning that Travis Kelce purchased a Lake Erie mansion.

3.title: ‘We Can Understand Parts of Her Story’: Moms React to Clancy’s Experience
3.summary: Some moms are outraged and called for Lindsay Clancy’s conviction. Others watched with compassion, recognizing their own struggles with postpartum.

4.title: Trump $1 coin makes him first living president on US currency in a century
4.summary: The US Mint special edition is stamped with a portrait of Trump alongside the words "LIBERTY" and "IN GOD WE TRUST"

5.title: Spain’s Leader Questions Morocco Border Control During Ceuta Migrant Surge
5.summary: Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez of Spain said the role of Moroccan authorities at key moments needed to be “clarified.” But he rejected any suggestion they had planned the crisis.

6.title: Palestinian teens killed during settler attack on West Bank village, officials say
6.summary: Al-Mughayyir's council says they were trying to stop settlers stealing sheep, but the Israeli military says they threw stones at its troops.
